issues.description: Method signature mismatch for SealSaloon.checkOrderReady: The problem statement (UML and text) specifies a parameterless method checkOrderReady(): void (problem_statement.md declares +checkOrderReady(): void). The reference solution implements a different signature public void checkOrderReady(boolean enableLogging) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java and calls it from orderMeal as this.checkOrderReady(true). This divergence between the required no-argument method and the solution's boolean-parameter variant will confuse students about the exact method they must implement and how to call it (compilation/correctness of student code vs. tests may be affected).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution and specification consistent. Preferred fixes: (A) Change the solution to provide the parameterless method required by the spec: add public void checkOrderReady() and have orderMeal call this.checkOrderReady(); implement the logic there (optionally delegate to the existing boolean variant). Or (B) if the boolean parameter is intentional for logging, update the problem statement and UML to declare checkOrderReady(boolean enableLogging): void and document its purpose. Ensure all callers in the solution and tests use the same signature.
